description: The address-map membership URIs take TWO account ids: the owning account and the account being added/removed as a member. The docs name both path params `account_id`, so the converter dedup produced the meaningless member `account_id_2` — and left the URI with `{account_id}` twice, which the runtime's first-occurrence label substitution can never fill. Rename the member to `member_account_id` and point the second URI placeholder at it.

patches.value: Identifier of the Cloudflare account to add as a member of the address map.
Identifier of the Cloudflare account to remove from the address map.
